prompt: A money app turns dollars into euros with $e(d) = 0.9d$, then turns euros into yen with $y(e) = 160e$. You start with $\$50$. How many yen do you end with?
hint: Two machines in a row. Dollars must become euros FIRST.

hints.text: Two machines in a row. Dollars must become euros FIRST.
$e(50) = 0.9 \times 50 = 45$ euros. Now feed 45 into the yen machine.

alternativeExplanations.title: Follow the money on a trip
steps: You hand over $\$50$ at the first window and walk out with 45 euros.
You carry those 45 euros to the second window.
Each euro is swapped for 160 yen, so you leave with $45 \times 160 = 7200$ yen.
